summary: Refactored the agent-server session creation flow to read workspace profiles through a new `activeProfileFor` helper, and introduced a `PiSessionRuntimeOptions` type that carries `extensionTools` and `extensionPrompt` flags derived from the active profile's tool/prompt modes. The createSession, resumeSession, and createDefaultPiSession paths were updated to pass these flags and gate the runScript tool plus system-prompt override accordingly. Prettier was then run across the touched files.
decisions: Added `ProjectCatalog.activeProfileFor(projectPath)` to return the resolved profile (with default fallback) and rewrote `integrationsFor` to delegate to it, so profile-driven configuration is sourced from one place.

Defined `PiSessionRuntimeOptions = SessionOptions & { extensionTools?: boolean; extensionPrompt?: boolean }` as the factory input shape, deriving `extensionTools` from `profile.tools?.mode === 'default-plus-extension'` and `extensionPrompt` from `profile.prompt?.mode === 'default-plus-extension-fragments'`.
Gated the extra `runScript` tool and the `systemPromptOverride` on the new `extensionTools` / `extensionPrompt` flags inside `createDefaultPiSession`, replacing the previous unconditional inclusion.
Applied Prettier formatting across the agent-server, app, and extension packages that were touched (or confirmed unchanged).
errors: An edit to pi-agent-service.ts initially failed with 'Could not find edits[2]' because the third oldText block didn't match exactly; after re-reading the relevant offsets it was reapplied successfully as 3 block replacements.
`rg 'function createDefaultPiSession'` exited 1 with no matches; a broader `rg createDefault` located the definition at line 785.
`git diff --check` exited 2 with CRLF/LF warnings on several files and a 'new blank line at EOF' notice for extensions/registry.ts; formatting was addressed by running Prettier on the affected files.
